item.title: Lucasfilm and the Walt Disney Studios Announce Leadership Transition
item.description: As heavily rumoured last week, Lucasfilm has announced that after 14 years of leading the studio, President Kathleen Kennedy is stepping down with Dave Filoni leading the studio as President and Chief Creative Officer alongside Lynwen Brennan as Co-President. The post Lucasfilm and the Walt Disney Studios Announce Leadership Transition appeared first on Jedi News.
